epics.title: Migrate engineering BOM integration to event-driven APIs
epics.description: Replace the nightly batch file transfer between PLM and SAP with event-driven API integration.
epics.business_outcome: Released BOMs reach SAP in under 15 minutes instead of next day.

features.title: BOM release event publisher in PLM
features.description: Publish a release event whenever an EBOM is released.

features.title: SAP material and BOM upsert service
features.description: Consume release events and create or update materials and BOMs in SAP.

wsjf.rationale: Unblocks same-day BOM delivery; in progress, so finishing it is urgent.

features.title: Integration error dashboard
features.description: Show failed BOM transfers with the reason and a retry action.

wsjf.rationale: Small job that cuts silent integration failures.

epics.title: Engineering data governance foundation
epics.description: Define ownership, quality rules, and stewardship for part and document master data.
epics.business_outcome: Part master completeness above 95% for released parts.

features.title: Part classification standard
features.description: Common classification schema across business units.

features.title: Data quality scorecard
features.description: Weekly completeness and validity scores by business unit.

wsjf.rationale: Makes data quality visible by business unit; not time critical.

epics.title: PLM platform security hardening
epics.description: Close findings from the annual PLM cybersecurity assessment.
epics.business_outcome: Zero open high-severity findings on the PLM platform.

features.title: Single sign-on and MFA for all PLM roles
features.description: Move remaining local accounts to enterprise SSO with MFA.

wsjf.rationale: Open cybersecurity finding; high risk reduction, blocked on identity team.

features.title: Export-controlled data access review
features.description: Quarterly attestation of who can access ITAR/EAR-controlled items.
